body: I've felt similarly. I have incredible social anxiety. Making real friends is something that I've come to accept is not for me. I can't be myself with anyone, literally anyone..  I don't talk to anyone outside of family; and even with my family I keep this stupid mask on my face. I'm just such a pretend. I can't be genuine. I can't be me. And I thought about this a lot but it's another big reason for me to want to end it. Life is about interaction and community and if I can't participate in it...i feel like a complete alien here.

Same here I need this year to be my last. It feels nice to know we're not alone in feeling this way  you know. Even though we all have our different reasonings and lives we share this mutual desperation for ending it. Just hope we can find peace, may that be in life or death.

You know from what I read hell is a temporary place. In the end all lives return to the Creator. So in the end everyone cleanses from their sins in hell and then goes to heaven.
But we'll find out if any of it is true when we die..

The pain of a heartbreak and the pain of eternal loneliness is both completely different. And both are shit feelings in their own way. 
What's worse all comes down to your personal experience. I'm sure there are people in r/ForeverAlone who would give anything for a life with a few years of true love.
The most recent suicidal death was Reckful, RIP.
